title: Error Handler & Request Logger Middleware
goal: Implement centralized error handling with custom error classes and request logging middleware with unique request IDs for request tracing.

sub_tasks.title: Create Custom Error Classes
sub_tasks.output: Implemented AppError base class and specialized errors: ValidationError (400), AuthError (401), ForbiddenError (403), NotFoundError (404)

sub_tasks.title: Implement Global Error Handler
sub_tasks.output: Created errorHandler middleware that catches all errors, logs them via Winston, and returns appropriate HTTP responses

sub_tasks.title: Create Request Logger Middleware
sub_tasks.output: Implemented requestLogger that generates unique request IDs (UUID), tracks response time, and logs all requests with metadata

sub_tasks.title: Add X-Request-Id Header
sub_tasks.output: Request logger attaches X-Request-Id header to all responses for distributed tracing

acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes for common HTTP error codes
Global error handler catches all errors
Unexpected errors logged as errors with stack traces
Request logger generates UUID for each request
All requests logged with method, path, status, IP, user agent
Different log levels based on response status (info for 2xx/3xx, warn for 4xx, error for 5xx)
result_summary: Comprehensive error handling and request logging system. Custom error classes provide type-safe error handling with appropriate HTTP status codes. Global error handler ensures consistent error responses and logging. Request logger tracks every request with unique UUID, enabling distributed tracing and debugging. Response time monitoring helps identify performance issues.
